title: Stability bound under maximum influence control
statement: There is a constant $C>0$ such that, for every dimension $n$ and every function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ with $0\le f(x)\le1$ for all $x$, the following holds. If $0<\varepsilon\le e^{-2}$ and the maximum absolute coordinate influence of $f$ is at most $\varepsilon$, then for every $0<\rho<1$, $\operatorname{Stab}_\rho(f)\le H_\rho(\mathbb E f)+\frac{C\log\log(1/\varepsilon)}{(1-\rho)\log(1/\varepsilon)}$, where $H_\rho(\alpha)$ denotes the Gaussian halfspace stability at correlation $\rho$ and volume $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number dimension $n$ and function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$
